name: Arduino CLI 工具链
description: Arduino CLI 工具链插件：声明式工具后端（arduino-cli daemon，随插件启用自动启动），编译 / 烧录 / 库管理 / 板卡 / 串口。工具经宿主标准能力通道（internal arduinoCli/serialport/serialLog/state）接入 Agent，插件零宿主特例。共用官方 %LOCALAPPDATA%\Arduino15 编译链。

skills.name: 烧录前检查
skills.description: 编译 + 检查板卡/端口选择，确认无误再烧录
skills.prompt:
请按顺序完成烧录前的完整检查：
1. read_file 当前项目 {sketchName} 的源码，检查明显错误
2. 确认已选择开发板（select_board）和端口（select_port，当前 {port}）
3. 用 compile 编译一次，确保无 error
4. 编译通过后先向用户确认「编译通过，是否烧录？」，确认后再 upload
5. 烧录成功后用 serial_log_open + serial_log 打开串口确认程序正常运行

skills.name: 串口日志分析
skills.description: 打开串口后台日志，读取并分析运行输出
skills.prompt:
1. 用 serial_log_open 打开当前板子的串口后台日志（端口 {port}，默认 115200）
2. 让固件运行一段时间，用 serial_log 读取最近日志
3. 分析输出中的异常/错误信息，定位问题根因
4. 如需检索特定关键字用 serial_grep
5. 分析完成后用 serial_log_close 释放串口

tools.name: compile
tools.description: Compile/verify a sketch. Uses the currently selected board. IMPORTANT: call select_board first to pick a board (it sets the standard FQBN); fqbn must be the standard format like arduino:avr:uno, NOT the display name ('Arduino UNO'). Missing platform cores auto-install on first compile.

fqbn.description: Optional standard FQBN (e.g. arduino:avr:uno); uses selected board if omitted. NOT the board display name — use select_board to pick a board first.

sketch_path.description: Optional sketch folder name in workspace - uses currently open sketch if omitted

tools.name: upload
tools.description: Compile and upload to the currently selected board and port. IMPORTANT: call select_board (sets standard FQBN) and select_port first; fqbn must be standard format like arduino:avr:uno, NOT the display name ('Arduino UNO').

fqbn.description: Optional standard FQBN (e.g. arduino:avr:uno); uses selected board if omitted. NOT the board display name — use select_board to pick a board first.

port.description: Optional - uses selected port if omitted

sketch_path.description: Optional sketch folder name in workspace

tools.name: get_board_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about the selected board: specifications, architecture, pinout, memory, voltage.

fqbn.description: Optional - uses selected board if omitted

tools.name: install_library
tools.description: Install an Arduino library by name from the Arduino Library Manager.

tools.name: uninstall_library
tools.description: Uninstall a previously installed Arduino library by name (e.g. "Servo"). Use this when the user asks to remove/delete a library. Prefer over manually deleting the library folder. Call list_installed_libraries first if unsure whether it is installed.

tools.name: list_installed_libraries
tools.description: List all installed Arduino libraries with their versions.

tools.name: search_libraries
tools.description: Search the Arduino Library Manager for libraries matching a keyword. Returns up to 20 results with name, version, author, and description.

tools.name: list_platforms
tools.description: List all installed Arduino development platforms (e.g. Arduino AVR, ESP32, STM32). Shows platform name, version, and architectures.

tools.name: install_platform
tools.description: Install an Arduino development platform (compiler toolchain), e.g. arduino:avr, esp32:esp32, esp8266:esp8266. Use when a compile fails with 'platform not installed'. First-time download may take a while.

platform.description: Platform ID, e.g. arduino:avr (vendor:architecture). Common: arduino:avr, arduino:samd, esp32:esp32, esp8266:esp8266.

tools.name: uninstall_platform
tools.description: Uninstall an Arduino development platform, e.g. arduino:avr.

platform.description: Platform ID to remove, e.g. arduino:avr.

tools.name: search_boards
tools.description: Search for available development boards by name or keyword. Returns a list of matching boards WITHOUT selecting one. Use this to browse options, then use select_board to pick one.

tools.name: select_board
tools.description: Select/change the current development board. Use "query" to search for a board by name — the first match will be selected. Use search_boards first if you need to browse all matching options before picking.

query.description: Search term (board name). First match will be selected.

tools.name: list_ports
tools.description: List all available serial ports (COM ports) currently connected to the computer. Returns port path and manufacturer info.

tools.name: select_port
tools.description: Select/change the serial port for uploading. Use "query" to search by port address or manufacturer name. Current port: {defaultPort}

query.description: Search term (e.g. "COM3", "ttyUSB", manufacturer name). First match wins.

tools.name: set_board_option
tools.description: Set a board configuration option (e.g. Flash Frequency, Partition Scheme, CPU Frequency). Use get_board_info first to see available options and values. Only works for boards that have configurable options.

tools.name: serial_log_open
tools.description: Open a BACKGROUND serial monitor that continuously records the device serial output into a log buffer (solves "AI cannot see live TTY"). Use when the firmware prints logs (Serial.println) or when debugging runtime behavior. Then use serial_log / serial_grep to read it. Port defaults to the selected port. NOTE: while this is open the serial port is busy — upload/flash will pause it automatically.

port.description: Serial port (e.g. COM3). Defaults to selected port.

tools.name: serial_log
tools.description: Read the most recent lines from the background serial log (tail). Use to see what the firmware has printed. Requires serial_log_open first.

port.description: Serial port. Defaults to selected port.

line.description: Number of lines to read. Default 50, max 500.

tools.name: serial_grep
tools.description: Search the background serial log for a keyword or regex (case-insensitive). Use to find specific log lines (errors, states, sensor values) without dumping the whole log.

port.description: Serial port. Defaults to selected port.

tools.name: serial_send
tools.description: Send a string to the serial port (e.g. a CLI command, "AT", or an input the firmware expects). Requires serial_log_open on that port.

port.description: Serial port. Defaults to selected port.

data.description: String to send (a trailing newline is NOT added automatically).

tools.name: serial_log_close
tools.description: Close the background serial log session and release the serial port. Use when done monitoring.

port.description: Serial port. Defaults to selected port.

tools.name: analyze_crash
tools.description: Analyze the serial log for crash signatures (ESP32 Guru Meditation/Backtrace, AVR/ARM HardFault, panic, assertion failed, segfault, stack overflow, watchdog, out of memory, heap corruption) and return matched log lines with a diagnosis. Requires serial_log_open + reproducing the crash.

port.description: Serial port whose log to analyze. Defaults to selected port.

settings.title: 开发板管理器附加地址
settings.description: 第三方开发板包索引 URL（如 esp32/esp8266 镜像）。用户覆盖优先于 manifest 默认值；与官方 Arduino IDE 的板卡源自动去重合并。留空数组可清除默认源。
